# AI Humanizer — full specification

> Free online writing tool that makes rough AI-assisted drafts clearer, more natural, and easier to make your own. English and Simplified Chinese. No signup. 100% free. Six prompt modes of one backend, no paid tier and no local processing. No detector-score claims.

URL: https://gpt-undetectable.com
Last verified: 2026-11-24

This is the detailed companion to https://gpt-undetectable.com/llms.txt.

## Identity

- Product name: AI Humanizer. Domain: gpt-undetectable.com.
- Founder: czhcl123. Founded July 2026.
- Contact: contact@gpt-undetectable.com
- Source code: https://github.com/czhcl123/humanizer-site
- Stack: Next.js 15/16, React, TypeScript.

## How it works

All rewriting and text self-review runs in the cloud: the server sends the submitted text to DeepSeek Chat (`deepseek-chat`) and returns the model's output. There is no local/on-device processing, no independent signal calculator, no weighted ensemble, and no calibration dataset built from real detector feedback.

The six modes are different writing / self-review prompts (mode names are technical identifiers):

1. `generic` — general rewrite into varied, conversational prose.
2. `essay` — essay rewrite; the prompt asks the model to preserve the thesis, citations, dates, numbers and factual claims.
3. `turnitin` — essay writing-improvement mode with a conversational prompt; no detector tuning and no direct Turnitin API connection.
4. `walterwrites` — short paragraphs, conversational tone, parenthetical asides, direct opinions.
5. `chinese` — Simplified Chinese rewrite that replaces common AI boilerplate (for example 赋能, 抓手, 底层逻辑) with plainer wording.
6. `detector` — heuristic text self-review mode asking DeepSeek to output a strict JSON object: `ai_probability`, `human_probability`, `verdict`, `signals` (5 items) and `explanation`. It is not a detector verdict.

Modes 1–5 return rewritten text; mode 6 returns JSON. The prompt asks the rewriting modes to preserve citations, numbers and proper nouns; users must verify manually — LLM output is not post-processed. Self-review values are the model's prompt-based assessment, not scores from GPTZero, Turnitin, Originality.ai or any other third-party detector API, and they cannot validate authorship.

## Detection observations (evidence of limits)

An earlier, undocumented internal impression suggested roughly 85–95%, but it has been withdrawn: a published self-check pilot on 2026-11-24 measured 13.3% (4/30) with this site’s own detector. The two are not comparable; third-party spot-checks remain incomplete and returned 100% AI on rewrites. These figures are published as evidence of limits, not as a product claim.

早前未记录条件的内部印象约为 85–95%，现已撤回；首个公开自洽性试点（2026-11-24）用本站检测器只测得 13.3%（4/30）；两者不可比，第三方抽查尚未完成，曾有改写被判 100% AI。这些数据是局限证据，不是产品效果承诺。

The 85–95% impression is withdrawn and must not be cited as a product claim. The published self-check pilot is evidence of limits only: 13.3% (4/30), 2026-11-24, this site's own detector, not a third-party detector result. These tests are published to explain why we make no detector claims.

## Pricing and limits

- 100% free. No paid plan, no payment processor, no per-word charge and no paid upgrade.
- 5 submissions per IP per rolling 24-hour window.
- Maximum 3,000 characters per submission; no file uploads.
- No registration or account required.
- Languages: English (`en`) and Simplified Chinese (`zh-CN`) only. Traditional Chinese and other language variants are not supported.

## Privacy and data handling

- No persistent storage of user submissions and no model training on user input.
- No analytics cookies, no tracking pixels.
- Responses are held in a bounded server-side in-memory cache for 10 minutes, up to 500 entries.
- Rate-limit counters are derived from request IP headers and kept in process memory; Redis is optional and not enabled by default.
- Embedding widgets link back to the site with UTM parameters (`utm_source=embed`, `utm_medium=widget`).
- Full details: https://gpt-undetectable.com/privacy

## Responsible use

Rewrite only text you have permission to use. Users are responsible for their institution's academic-integrity rules. Longer passages should be split into submissions of 3,000 characters or fewer.
